title: Minshop client manifest, schema version 1

schemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest format. Bumped only by the core.

coreVersion.description: Core version (SemVer tag) this shop was cloned from or last upgraded to.

slug.description: Fleet-wide identifier. Becomes part of every Cloudflare resource name.

displayName.description: Human name of the shop, as shown to operators.

locale.description: Storefront locale. Single-valued while the offer is France-only.

timezone.description: Business time zone used for order timestamps and reports.

currency.description: Settlement currency. Multi-currency is out of scope.

market.description: Market the shop is certified for.

checkoutMode.description: Checkout mode. Guest-only until customer accounts are certified.

defaultVatRate.description: Default French VAT rate applied when a product declares none.

invoiceStrategy.description: Billing document strategy. `pending-validation` means the accounting review of plan §6 (jalon 3) has not happened yet.

features.description: Feature switches decided at build time. Runtime toggles live in Admin → Settings.

semanticSearch.description: Vector search. Out of scope for the pilot (plan §2.2).

digitalProducts.description: Downloadable products served from the private bucket.

shipping.description: Physical shipping and its rate table.

cloudflare.description: Runtime home of the shop. Every name here is account-visible.

jurisdiction.description: D1 and R2 jurisdiction. EU-only while the offer is French (ADR 0004).

workerName.description: Worker name, and the stem of every other resource name. Must be `minshop-<slug>`.

productionDomain.description: Custom production domain of the storefront.

provider.description: Email provider. Credentials never appear here.

id.description: Theme id, matching a directory under src/themes/.

x-crossFieldRules.description: client.slug must not be a name the platform already uses.
A guest-only checkout cannot advertise customer accounts.
The French B2C market sells at tax-inclusive prices.
Features outside the certified scope stay off.
A shop is reachable on its own domain, not a platform subdomain.
No API key, token or secret in the manifest.
